primary_sources.title: Investigating Causal Relations by Econometric Models and Cross-spectral Methods
primary_sources.claim_boundary: Motivates comparing restricted and remote-history-augmented prediction. It does not establish structural causality, P1 anomaly precision, or cross-station transport.

primary_sources.title: Cross-Sensor Quality Assurance for Marine Observatories
primary_sources.claim_boundary: Motivates validation against related datasets that reflect the same phenomenon. It does not show that geographically separate P1 stations are related sensors or that this recipe improves P1.

candidate_sealed_before_target_access.name: causal cross-station layer-1 restricted-versus-unrestricted predictive residual
candidate_sealed_before_target_access.restricted_predictors: own station layer-1 history at fixed lags
candidate_sealed_before_target_access.unrestricted_predictors: restricted predictors plus both other stations' layer-1 histories at the same fixed lags

target_free_support_gate.rationale: A remote-history observable must add stable label-free prediction information, not merely seasonal level correlation or a pooled average driven by fewer than half of days.

p1_cross_station_peer_residual.relation: Earlier P1 code subtracted contemporaneous other-station values and independent QA rejected that geographic peer residual as unrelated-regime contamination. v51 would use lagged predictive residuals, but it still relies on the same unestablished cross-station relatedness premise.

p1_conditional_dependence_change.relation: v9 changes within-series covariance and precision over time; it is not the same estimator, but closes dependence-change threshold retuning.

p3_pairwise_predictive_causality.relation: The repository already contains the same restricted-versus-unrestricted lagged regression and Granger predictive-causality representation. P1 changes variables and decoder, not the mathematical mechanism.

repository_negative_fingerprint.horizontal_graph: Not used: no station adjacency or propagation graph is asserted.
repository_negative_fingerprint.dynamic_factor: Not used: prefix subspace/common-mode estimation would repeat the closed robust-subspace and state-space lineages.

decision.reason: Timestamp occupancy passes, but stable label-free remote predictive information does not: no station improves on a strict majority of pre-Q2 days. The same predictive-causality mechanism also already exists repository-wide, and the related-station premise was previously rejected in P1 QA.
decision.next_research_gap: A genuinely non-reconstructible, contemporaneous physical driver shared across at least two P1 stations, or a fresh independent labeled transport window, is required before another cross-station action mechanism is identifiable.
